name: @chestor/db-schema-ui
title: Database Schema
description: Renderer web component for the database-schema workspace kind — the live schema graph.

wippy.description: Renders and edits one database-schema workspace component. Pass the component id through the entry-id attribute; mode may be preview or manage. The renderer loads the normalized schema through the host API and keeps the graph synchronized with component events.

entry-id.description: Database-schema workspace component id to load. An empty value renders the no-schema state.

mode.description: Rendering context supplied by the workspace host; preview is read-only and full enables the complete editor.

read-only.description: Keeps the full reading surface available and disables changes for a shared reader.
